commands.command: Create a small config-gated capability-belief auxiliary candidate or actor-coupling smoke, then evaluate it with the M154 gate before any PPO promotion.
commands.name: m155_capability_belief_aux_candidate_smoke

decision_rule: A capability-belief candidate is admitted only if the training path preserves the P0 actor input contract and is evaluated against the M154 behavior gate.
failure_criteria: candidate changes actor observations or adds hidden dynamics at inference
candidate is promoted from supervised losses without M154 gate evidence
candidate skips behavior retention or critical-key replay
candidate trains broad PPO before a smoke-scale integration
hypothesis: A small capability-belief auxiliary candidate can be produced from the M153 recurrent objective and then judged by the M154 behavior gate without relaxing the human-view input contract.
success_criteria: produce a concrete checkpoint or explain why no candidate should be produced yet
prove actor observation contract remains P0 human-view only
report capability-belief target and pairwise delta losses
run at least the cheap M154 pre-screens before expensive strict miners
record whether full M154 gate execution is justified
